# Project rules

- Stack: React.js (Vite), functional components + hooks, plain CSS
- Sirf wahi change karo jo maanga hai, extra refactor mat karo
- Jawab short rakho, explanation sirf maangne pe
- Naming: components PascalCase, functions/variables camelCase
- Naye packages bina poochhe install mat karo
- Bade change se pehle 2-3 line ka plan batao
